content.text: The document meets the preferred position; no redline needed.

input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: The Agreement meets the preferred position: § 2.1 expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment, confirms Customer pays only for Services ordered under an executed Order Form, and provides that declining to place further orders is not a breach or shortfall. § 7.1 bars any minimum-use or similar charge not identified in the Order Form, and § 12.3 confirms Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment. No take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or volume cap on Customer usage appears anywhere; the only "shortfall" references (§§ 22.2–22.3) are usage-audit true-ups for actual underpayment, which is consistent with the playbook's true-up approach. No redline required.
